create_supervised_keypoint: create a SupervisedKeypoint task with batch_to_images_and_labels_fn, images_to_logits_fn, and optional image augmentation transform
build_training_loss_pipeline: build a training loss pipeline that applies image augmentation and computes CrossEntropyLoss on augmented logits
build_validation_loss_pipeline: build a validation loss pipeline that computes CrossEntropyLoss on non-augmented logits
run_supervised_keypoint_forward: run the SupervisedKeypoint forward pass to compute training and validation losses from a batch
test_image_aug_transform: test the image_aug_transform method to apply data augmentation or warn when no transform is provided
